$comment: Bake config for the Constantinople city view. bbox = [west, south, east, north] in degrees; covers the walled peninsula, the Golden Horn to Kağıthane, Galata/Pera and the Asian shore at Chrysopolis and Chalcedon. demZoom = Terrarium tile zoom for fetch-dem.mjs --city.
